title: Sarawak Digital Billboard Network 2026 — Kuching & Bintulu
summary: Three LED double-screen sites from RM500/day or RM15k/month single screen; 2-site 10% and 3-site 15% bundles.
description: Sarawak Media Group (SMG) digital billboard rate card. Three double-screen LED sites: Taman Heritage, Kuching (20ft x 50ft, 1536x624px, 138,546 daily traffic); Jalan Tun Salahuddin, Kuching (40ft x 30ft, 864x1248px, 129,726 daily); Jalan Tun Taib, Bintulu (40ft x 30ft, 864x1248px, 110,297 daily). Each slot is 15 seconds, 12 slots per 3-minute loop, 18 operating hours daily. Single screen RM500/day, RM3,500/week, RM15,000/month; double screen RM1,000/day, RM7,000/week, RM30,000/month. Bundles: two sites 10% off (from RM900/day single screen), three sites 15% off (from RM1,275/day single screen). Rates exclude tax and a RM500 management charge per material. Cross-city introductory promotion runs 1 June–31 July 2026. A fourth Miri site at Jalan Padang (opposite Miri Clocktower) is scheduled for completion on 30 November 2026; rates to be confirmed.
validity: 2026; Miri site expected 30 Nov 2026; cross-city promotion 1 Jun–31 Jul 2026
